title: Update replay vision scanner
description: Partially update a replay vision scanner by ID. Send only the fields you want to change. Common changes: toggle `enabled` to pause/resume scanning, adjust `sampling_rate` or `sampling_mode`, tweak the `scanner_config` prompt or tags, or refine the `query` to watch a different slice of sessions. `scanner_type` is locked after creation — to change it, delete and recreate. Editing any config field bumps `scanner_version`; existing observations keep a snapshot of the previous config for reproducibility. If you widen the `query`, raise `sampling_rate`, loosen `sampling_mode`, or move to a pricier `model`, re-check projected spend with `vision-scanners-estimate` and remaining budget with `vision-quota-get` first — the scanner resumes sweeping every 5 minutes at the new, broader scope.
